purpose: Paper-oriented post-ablation evaluation for the completed anchor0624 2^4 factorial checkpoints, plus a paper-aligned external baseline comparison layer. The goal is to separately answer: (1) whether the current anchor0624 method is competitive with original-paper baselines under 5x5/B=10/C={4,5,6,7,8}; and (2) whether the MASA-shared 0.6240 anchor and its ablated variants transfer across domain and goal modality.

original_paper_alignment.core_protocol: 5x5 grid, search budget B=10, distance buckets C={4,5,6,7,8}, greedy/argmax numerical evaluation; stochastic policy only for visualization.
paper_items_to_cover: Table 3 xBD-disaster transfer once processed xBD arrays are available
Table 5 method ablation context, reported separately from our anchor0624 mechanism ablation
Supplementary SG metric and optional SwissView100 transfer
original_paper_alignment.separation_rule: External method comparison and anchor0624 mechanism ablation must be interpreted as two evidence layers, not merged into one causal claim.

paper_baseline_compare_layer.purpose: Replicate the original paper's method-comparison style before interpreting our added mechanisms.
methods_in_current_launcher: Random policy on aerial-goal comparable settings
GOMAA-Geo on aerial/ground/text and SwissViewMonuments settings

blocked_or_not_applicable.PPO policy: No validated standalone PPO baseline checkpoint/evaluator is available in this local bundle for all requested paper settings.
blocked_or_not_applicable.AiRLoc: Existing AiRLoc bundle is unimodal aerial and MASA-layout specific; do not report it on ground/text without a validated adapter.
blocked_or_not_applicable.xBD Table 3/S3: Requires remote processed xBD pre/post arrays and a rechecked pre-disaster-goal evaluator path.

design.checkpoint_panel: All 16 trained factorial cells, seed 321, 480k timesteps, best-val checkpoint geoexplorer.pt.

factor_panel.G_gate: distance gate on intrinsic reward, off none/floor=1.0, on linear/floor=0.405
factor_panel.P_pbrs: potential-based reward shaping, off coef=0.0, on coef=0.10
factor_panel.V_val78: checkpoint selection validation distances, off 4,5,6,7,8, on 7,8

design.protocol: Fixed greedy evaluation with 5x5 grid, B=10, C={4,5,6,7,8}, repeats-per-distance=5, fixed task-bank seed 20260516 for generated non-shared benchmarks.

blocked_extensions.xbd_pre_post: Blocked because remote processed xBD grids were previously absent: /root/geoexplorer/GeoExplorer/data/xbd/processed/xbd_pre_grid_5.npy and xbd_post_grid_5.npy. Local raw tar archives and prepare_xbd_embeddings.py exist, so this should be a separate data-prep/evaluator-audit stage.

Compare the full anchor g1_p1_e1_v1 against same-data control g0_p0_e0_v0 and the best transfer runner-up.
